cohorts.summary: Stepping past initial performance issues reveals a large roster of killers, though the community and solo queue experience can be rough.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game is janky and full of bugs affecting lobbies, the main menu, and hitboxes.

citations.review_text: iTS VERY GLITCHY CANT EVEN JOIN MY FRIENDS PARTY TEH GAME ALWAYS CRASH AND YOU KNOW ITS BAD WHEN THERES GLITCHES AND BUGS IN THE LOBBY/MAIN MENU IM RETURNING

I already have over 322 hours on Epic, and this game absolutely needs a competitor. It's full of bugs, really janky, and inconsistent with killer abilities and hitboxes for both killers and survivors.
Their events are also getting lazier and lazier. This year's Halloween event is just taking 1/3 of the event from 2023 and changing the colors of the Haunts. What used to be 50% discounts on all characters is now 25%.
The game is behind a paywall, and you also need to buy the characters you want to play (you can unlock unlicensed characters for free, but it's going to take you a very long time). Even after you unlock the characters, you're going to be bombarded with newsletters advertising new skins for them, which are even more expensive in some cases, more than three times the price of a character.
There are also no real updates, just character and skin releases. Since the beginning of the game's existence, they've added only one new mode (2v8), and it's time-limited, meaning it's only playable a few times a year.
The devs are getting lazier and greedier every year.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as more enjoyable when playing with friends compared to playing solo.

citations.review_text:
This game can be fun when playing with friends, but playing alone it's absolutely miserable....

Playing survivor is one of the worst roles in this game. It's boring, all you do is wait and sometimes skill check. When there's a killer you run away. When you get caught, you also wait and sometimes skill check until a teammate saves you. It's not fun, it's not scary It's boring and quite frustrating. These skill checks are a boring cop out of actual gameplay that could be implemented in the game. 

Playing killer is a bit more fun. I tend to not tunnel and try to get everyone to 1 hook before giving a second hook, because I know how annoying it can be playing survivor and getting tunneled or just playing survivor. I want to give everyone a chance to play and actually DO something. But these Survivor players are the absolute worst of the worst and they do not deserve any of my generosity! All they do is spam flashlight spam pallets, they're not even afraid of me and they disrespect me. Every single one of them deserves to be tunneled and have a horrible game. These brain dead zombies called survivor, the only reason they're so cocky is because I wasn't a total jerk and tunneled them. Either way, I already hooked them all once or even twice, in reality they would already be dead. Absolutely embarrassing, imagine being cocky and twerking at the gate while being a zombie acting like you won the game. The only reason they "won" is because the game is survivor sided. 3 lives, a bunch of perks that allows mega speed and a bunch of other bs, 1 million pallets and all these other shadow buffs to help survivors when killer is not playing fair aka tunneling. 

Every buff, every nerf is not helping the game at all, it's just making it worst. AND THE PERKS!?!? You can't balance that! Whatever you do with it, you're going to have 1 guy who spends 20 hours a day on this horrible game and figures out some secret ninjitsu that makes him op and it will become meta. Imagine playing this…

It is an honestly stressful but fun game. As a survivor, repairing generators while constantly checking if the killer is nearby keeps me on edge. The chases around pallets and windows, risky rescues, and last-second escapes make every match exciting. And when the killer finally catches me after a long chase, I can't help but laugh out of frustration. Better to play with friends, and perks are kinda overwhelming in the beginning so I'll probably suggest that you'll just play along and understand it eventually...

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players highlight persistent balance issues between roles alongside end-game chat toxicity.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the community as toxic, noting that players frequently hurl insults and complaints in the end-game chat.

citations.review_text:
I absolutely love this game. The asymmetrical multiplayer gameplay is genuinely fun, whether you're playing as a Survivor or a Killer. There is a massive amount of DLC, which can be overwhelming, although you can also purchase it directly in game. However, the sheer amount of DLC isn't the biggest problem.

The game has tons of perks to create fun build (most hidden in DLC but still can be bought in game), but the community is extremely competitive, often to a ridiculous degree. Unfortunately, this also makes it incredibly toxic. The game itself has balance issues, and high MMR matches can be particularly unpleasant in chat.

No matter what you do, someone will find a reason to complain. If you're playing Killer, you'll be accused of tunneling, camping, abusing perks, or simply lacking skill, regardless of your playstyle. Survivors aren't much better when it comes to blaming each other.

Sometimes, the community makes you question whether you even want to keep playing. Imagine waiting 10 minutes as Killer, playing a 10-15 minute match, only to be greeted at the end by someone informing you that they've been having a very intimate relationship with you and your entire family tree. Truly a wonderful gaming experience.

Dead by Daylight is a fantastic game, and I genuinely love it. But for the sake of your own mental health, you're probably better off staying away from it. Sometimes, the best way to win is simply not to launch the game.

Pros:
+ Addictive asymmetrical multiplayer gameplay.
+ Huge variety of perks and possible builds.
+ Plenty of content and replayability.

Cons:
- An overwhelming amount of DLC.
- Balance issues.
- Extremely competitive and often toxic community.
- High MMR matches can be particularly unpleasant.
- Some killers need some more love from dev.

I like this game but the community is one of the worst I've even seen. When you play survivor you're always seeing someone whine in endgame chat when they get hooked out of the game. When you play Killer the community expects you to play by some made up nonexistent rules and if you don't then prepare to see insults and slurs hurled your way in chat. I don't understand why there is even a endgame chat to begin with. Let's not even get into how bad Gen rushing right now or how half the matches as Killer is up against discord groups who run troll builds where the game becomes a tedious mess for the next 10 minutes. I like this game a lot. Both roles can be really fun to play at times. The community really just bogs this game down.

Game WAS great until they constantly powercreep existing killers with more overpowered kits and perks. Dead by Daylight is now Dead by D*gsh*t designs and the game has never had any idea of what balancing is. 

The concept itself is great. It's not unplayable, not entirely unfun, but you'll realize that there's a LOT of annoying things in the game (FROM BOTH SIDES) that makes you just want to just commit, especially if you purely play solo like I do. It's the type of game you gravitate towards when you have nothing else to play; but ends up with you wishing you have something else to play.
